FluidPickup
Shared world pickup of one bucket unit, following the vanilla bucket rules: the block that owns the fluid gives it up through its own pickup contract, so a plain source block is removed, a waterlogged block keeps itself and loses only its water, and a block that refuses bucket pickup keeps its fluid.
